title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] Contract Renewal Quote total ignores the Billing Base Period and shows the base-period amount instead of the renewal-term amount
summary: Fix contract renewal quote totals to correctly apply billing rhythm conversions alongside base period conversions when calculating subscription line amounts.
key_points: Contract renewal quotes now show correct renewal-term amounts instead of base-period amounts
Bug occurred when Billing Base Period differed from Billing Rhythm; with 1M base and 12M rhythm, totals showed 100 instead of 1200
Root cause: contract-renewal branch omitted the base-period-to-rhythm conversion factor
Period count variables changed from threaded var parameters to local variables to prevent value leakage between lines
Added tests covering various billing period and rhythm combinations
